NAME: First Form: Water Surface Slash
TOOL TIP: A single clean horizontal slash. Lunges forward and cuts.

NAME: Fourth Form: Striking Tide
TOOL TIP: A rapid flurry of flowing strikes from changing angles.

NAME: Seventh Form: Drop Ripple Thrust
TOOL TIP: A concentrated piercing water-spear thrust that travels forward.

NAME: Eighth Form: Waterfall Basin
TOOL TIP: A powerful overhead downward slash that crashes the target into the ground.

NAME: Second Form: Water Wheel
TOOL TIP: An aerial vertical spinning slash. Use while airborne.

NAME: Sixth Form: Whirlpool
TOOL TIP: A spinning whirlpool that catches everyone nearby and flings them out.

NAME: Ninth Form: Splashing Water Flow, Turbulent
TOOL TIP: A defensive stance. Parries melee and bullets, then ripostes with a water cross-cut.

NAME: Fifth Form: Blessed Rain After the Drought
TOOL TIP: A single, merciful, decisive cut on one target. Slow but devastating.

NAME: Hinokami Kagura: Dance
TOOL TIP: Sun Breathing. A flaming horizontal slash, the foundational dance.

NAME: Clear Blue Sky into Raging Sun
TOOL TIP: Sun Breathing. A clearing spin flowing into a wide flame cleave.

NAME: Fire Wheel
TOOL TIP: Sun Breathing. A downward aerial flaming wheel that slams the ground.

NAME: Dragon Sun Halo Head Dance
TOOL TIP: Sun Breathing, Thirteenth Form. A continuous storm of flaming slashes ending in a solar burst.
